content: The Ultra-Generic AI System is a production-ready enterprise AI platform that integrates Microsoft Semantic Kernel (SK) Agent Framework v1.57+, SK Process Framework, Prompty declarative templates, Microsoft.Extensions.AI, and Ollama local LLM hosting. The system operates as a continuous 'strange loop' that plans, executes, checks, and reflects to self-optimize through a 4-level meta-cognitive hierarchy.
